oracle: I5: a deliberately delayed older autosave cannot replace merged bytes
what: Treat every causal snapshot as newer so an old request arriving last overwrites the merged draft

target.case: C1 late save: one editor's autosave is held in its browser while the others type and save in turn, then lands last; the live copies still converge (I1) and hold every token (I2), and the draft carries no decoration (DECOR, BODYATTR apart from S3) [N=2]
